tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshes bcu'i cho ga bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshes bcu'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rags pa tsam zhig blo la nges par bya'o/ /de nas cho ga'i go rim gyi sdom ni 'di yin te/ gnas khang byi dor brgyan byas la/ /maṇ+ḍal bshams shing yo byad tshogs/ /byin rlabs sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ /gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs/ /slob dpon yod na zhu 'bul bya/ /bdag bskyed bzlas pa lag byin rlabs/ /mdun bskyed ye shes spyan drangs nas/ /mchod dang gtor ma la sogs bya/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*/ /mthar ni rjes chog bya ba yin/ /spro zhing shes na mchod pa yi/ /sngon du lag mchod bya bar bshad/ /ma grub na yang nyes pa med/ /ces bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal bshams pa ni/ dbus su dri bzang gi thig le gru bzhi/ lha'i gnas gzhan rnams su thig le zlum po re re/ dri bzang gi lde gu'i tshom bu dang bcas pa bshams/ dri bzang gi lde gu'i tshom bu ma 'byor na/ dri bzang gi chu'i thig le steng du/ me tog gam 'bru'i tshom bu bya/ so sor 'god long ma byung na/ maṇ+ḍal la me tog bkram zhing*/ dbus su spungs pas chog mdun bskyed zhal tshur bstan pa'i g.yon du yi dam gtor ma dang*/ g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bshams mchod pa rnams ci bde bar bsgrigs pas chog rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod/ rol mo sogs 'dzoms par byas nas rdo rje gsor/ dril bu dkrol la suṃ bha brjod/ yang rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa sa la reg suṃ bha bzlas/ thog ma nyid du nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ tshogs pa yod cing tshogs kyi slob dpon yod na sgrub mchod ltar zhu 'bul rgyas par bya/ tshogs pa yod slob dpon med na mchod g.yog pas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ kun bzang rnam sprul= sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab/ tshogs pa med na ni zhu 'bul mi dgos so/

/de nas spro zhing long yod na mngon rtogs rdzogs par bdag bskyed bsgom/ bsdu na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya rnams song ba'i rjes su dag pa gsum tsam mo/ /lhan skyes tsam zhig bsgom kyang rung mod kyi/ 'dir 'bring po'i dbang du byas nas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzad kyi bar bsrung 'khor rdzogs par bsgom/ de'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la nam mkha'i nā da babs te/ hūṃ dang aṃ gnyis su gyur/ de las dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar gyur ces pa'i bar bsgom/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod na （《dzaṃ》+bzlas pa ） cung zad bya/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros te/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ ces pa nas/ rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ltar bya ste bdag bskyed do/ /de nas lag pa byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ lag pa g.yas pa'i srin lag gis g.yon pa la nang mchod gtor/ bsangs sbyangs/ lag mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba dang*/ 'dab ma rnams la g.yon bskor du/ oṃ oṃ baṃ/ oṃ haṃ yoṃ/ oṃ hrīṃ mam̐/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ sor mo lnga la mthe bong nas brtsams te/ oṃ oṃ ha/ oṃ na ma hi/ oṃ swāhā hūṃ/ oṃ bau ṣaṭ+ṭahe/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ sen mo rnams gcig tu 'dus pa las/ oṃ phaṭa haṃ/ de rnams go cha'i lha bcu gnyis kyi ngo bor gyur/ lag pa'i sa khams ltung byed ma/ chu khams gsod byed ma/ me khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlung khams gar dbang ma/ mkha' khams dra ba can gyi ngo bor gyur/ argaṃ nas/ shab+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod gtor ba tsam bya/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la/ bsangs sbyangs/ nang mchod gtor nas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/

maṇ+ḍal la reg pa'am reg par mos la/ oṃ pi ṭha u pa pi tha ya swāhā/ oṃ k+ṣe dra u pa k+ṣe ṭa ya swāhā/ oṃ tshan+to ha u pa tshan+to ha ya swāhā/ oṃ me la ka u pa me la ka ya swāhā/ oṃ sh+ma sha na u pa sh+ma sha na ya swāhā/ oṃ pi la pa u pa pi la ya swāhā/ zhes brjod/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor gdan dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par 'gyur/ pheṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spros te mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la 'khod pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog nas dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nas rdo rje phreng bas mtshan pa'o'i/ bar mkha' nang du dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bzhin no/ /snying ga'i hūṃ yig nas yo ga shud+dho3'i sngags kyi bar dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin no/ /de nas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ chu gnyis 'bul ba nas brtsams te/ /rdo rje'i glu'i bar mchod pa sde tshan bcu gnyis dkyil chog gi mchod pa'i skabs su 'bul ba ltar phul la/ slar yang lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes me tog blangs te dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lan gnyis dor/ de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying gnyis/ 'khor rnams la so so'i sngags dang thod pa bzhi la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sngar bzhin me tog re re maṇ+ḍal du gtor de nas lag pa g.yas pa me tog re re lag pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas su bzhag la/ oṃ baṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ ha sogs brjod/ rkang brgyad gnyis 'don pa bzhin du lag pa g.yon pa'i me tog de yang maṇ+ḍal la 'thor bar bya'o/ /pad skor gyi mthar thal sbyar spyi bor bzhag pas yo ga shud+dho3 brjod/ lag pa'i lha rnams go cha'i gnas su thim par mos/ gong gi lag pa byin rlabs dang 'di sdebs pas lag mchod bsdus pa yang tshang ba yin no/ /sum+bhas bsangs ba nas/

ha ho hri'i bar gtor ma byin rlabs kyang mngon rtogs bzhin/ mgron 'dir spyan 'dren mi dgos pas/ oṃ a ral+li ho sa ma s+t+waṃ nas kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis gtor ma gnyis po phul zhing 'phrin las bcol/ de nas yan lag bdun pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung sogs dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed smon lam sogs kyang ci shes bya'o/ /de rjes tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ byin dbab/ tshogs phud dang por bcad/ tshogs bsres/ yang phud cig phud dang po dang bsre bar phud gcig bcad la bzhag tshogs phud de gnyis lhan cig tu 'bul zhing bsngo/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bkye ste tshogs la longs spyad/ mthar bar phud bzhag pa de lhag gtor dang bsre/ tshogs lhag bsdus pa la kha khrus btab/ de rnams snod gcig tu spungs/ tshogs lhag bsngos te phyir gtong ba'i skabs/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma yang phyir btang ngo*/ /tshogs mchog ngag 'don ni logs su shes par bya'o/ /rjes chog ni/ mchod pa kha gsos/ byin rlabs/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ rjes chags/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams bya/ 'dod don zhu/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ yo ga shud+dho'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor rang la bsdu/ mgron gzhan rnams la gshegs gsol/ bris sku sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ bdag srung ba/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya ste/ phal cher dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar bshad pa'i rjes chog dang 'dra'o/ /mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i skabs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs phyi mchod dang*/ gos zung*/ rig ma bcu drug nang mchod/ gsang ba'i mchod pa/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba/ dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu/ me tog 'bul ba rnams ma chad par bya/ gzhan ji ltar 'os pa skabs dang sbyar zhing*/ de dag la yang sngags tsam brjod pa dang*/ tshigs bcad sbyar ba sogs long skabs dang bstun te/ rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa sbyar/ skabs 'di'i rjes chog la rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa med kyang chog go

/ji skad bshad pa 'di dag la go rim cung zad bsgyur kyang chog pa'i skabs 'ga' re yod do/ /de ltar na phyi rol mchod pa la brten te tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nag po zhabs lugs dang 'brel bar sgrub tshul gyi yi ge mdo tsam smos pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas so/ /bkra shis par gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshes bcu'i cho ga bzhugs/ - PAGE 252 -- PAGE 249 - - PAGE 248 -
